reasons: Claimed status is 'compliant' and the cited paragraphs support it: Section 14.2 gives Customer ownership of each Deliverable with a present assignment from Vendor plus personnel assignments and further assurances; Section 14.3 limits Vendor to pre-existing Vendor Technology and routes embedded Vendor Technology to the Section 13.2 perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence including modification and derivative works.

Section 14.1 confirms Customer retains Customer Data, Customer-provided material and independently developed IP with only a limited processing right to Vendor — no assignment of Customer IP or data, consistent with the deterministic check.
Section 14.4 expressly negates joint ownership absent a separate signed instrument, and feedback is voluntary with Customer retaining unrestricted use, so no walk-away trigger exists.

No redline or counterparty comment was proposed, which is the expected output for a compliant finding; the rationale correctly notes the narrow 'improve the Services' purpose, telemetry carve-out and the absence of an express sublicence right as minor sub-elements not warranting a redline.
